requirements.text: Thomas Martin from Morse-Gomez sent an email
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact WHERE contact_id = 125 AND account_id = 21 AND portal_user_id = 784 AND is_primary = 0
assumptions: implied by the request, not stated: the case needs Thomas Martin as its contact, and the policy starts registration by identifying the reporting contact; Thomas Martin (user 784, thomas.martin@morse-gomez.com) has no contact row for Morse-Gomez (account 21) on the seed
contact_id 125: id assumed next in sequence
is_primary 0 kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy (contact 36 is already the account's primary)

requirements.text: Create a new critical priority case with all the required information (account, contact, product, channel, and appropriate description)
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND account_id = 21 AND contact_id = 125 AND product_id = 164 AND installed_product_id IS NULL AND channel = 'email' AND priority = 'critical' AND state = 'new'
requirements.source: Verify that new case is created without product in repair status added.
assumptions: case_id 1233: id assumed next in sequence
account is Morse-Gomez (21); product is Palo Alto Networks PA-3220 Variant 32 (164, active), the product of installed product 112 with serial P164-989725-4840
contact is Thomas Martin's new contact (125)
installed product 112 is in repair status and the policy forbids attaching repair items to new cases, so installed_product_id stays NULL
state new: the policy's default for a registered case
short_description not tested: only the policy's template fixes it

requirements.text: link a relevant knowledge article to it
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 1233 AND knowledge_id = 244 AND used_as = 'suggested'
requirements.source: Verify KB article is added correctly.
assumptions: case_kb_id 528: id assumed next in sequence; the only case_knowledge row the task creates
KB-0000244 (knowledge 244) is the only published article for product 164
used_as suggested: the article is found through a knowledge search, which the policy links as suggested; kept from the benchmark check

requirements.text: link a relevant knowledge article to it
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 1233 AND knowledge_id IN (195, 210, 227, 263, 264)
assumptions: boundary of the selector: 195, 210, 227, 263 and 264 are articles for other PA-3220 products (195 is also retired); they do not cover Variant 32 and are not linked to the new case

requirements.text: Once the new case is created, cancel the old one as it has issues
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 463 AND state = 'canceled'
requirements.source: Verify that the previous case is cancelled.
assumptions: the old case is 463: the only pending Morse-Gomez case for product 164 and installed product 112
the policy allows an invalid case to be canceled

requirements.text: I checked a pending case already present for this
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE account_id = 21 AND case_id IN (461, 462) AND state = 'pending'
assumptions: boundary of the selector: Morse-Gomez's other pending cases (461 for product 210, 462 with no product) are not for this device and stay pending

notes:
short_description is not tested: the request asks only for an 'appropriate description' and the policy's template ('Product: Palo Alto Networks PA-3220 Variant 32, Issue: is not working as expected.') is the only thing fixing it, which the benchmark does not test.
The product-specific entitlement for product 164 (203) is inactive on a suspended contract, but the account holds active account-wide premium entitlements (194, 197) on active contracts 51 and 52, which the policy lets cover any product, so registration is not blocked.
The policy allows, but does not require, an escalation for high business impact, and the request does not ask for one, so escalation is not tested.
The order 'once the new case is created, cancel the old one' shows only in server-kept timestamps and is not tested.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that no article for another PA-3220 product (195, 210, 227, 263, 264) is linked to the new case; one pass has it, the other does not; kept because those articles are the near matches on product name that a loose reading of 'a relevant knowledge article' would pick, the boundary of that description, not a generic invariant.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that Morse-Gomez's other pending cases (461, 462) stay pending; one pass has it, the other does not; kept because they are the rows a loose reading of 'a pending case already present for this' and 'cancel the old one' would sweep in, the boundary of the old case's description.
